prompt: Which chemical tests was your client asked to take? Select all that apply.

options.label: A breath test (taken or refused)
A blood draw

prompt: Before deciding whether to take the breath test, did your client ask to contact anyone? Select all that apply.

options.label: An attorney
A relative or friend (not an attorney)

prompt: If a relative or friend was requested, what was the stated or apparent purpose of that request?

options.label: To get advice on whether to take the test, or what to do (defense-related)
Purely personal — e.g. arranging bail, notifying family, emotional support — no defense-related purpose apparent
Not sure yet

_author_notes: To review later (the maintainer, 2026-10-10): decide whether to keep this question's 'Not sure yet' option (id 'unclear') or cut it, as was done for 17 other questions. Cutting it means also deleting what fires on that answer: near-miss purpose_unclear_needs_development in denial-of-contact-before-breath-test.

options.label: Request was denied outright — no opportunity to contact anyone was given
An opportunity was given, but your client was not able to communicate privately
An opportunity was given, but not within a reasonable time given the circumstances (e.g. the person could have arrived or advised further, but wasn't given the time to)
A reasonable opportunity to contact and consult was given

prompt: Was a breath test successfully completed (as opposed to being refused or not administered)?
Did the officer clearly and expressly advise your client of their right to an independent chemical test?

options.label: No advisement of the right to an independent test was given
An advisement was given, but it did not clearly and expressly explain the right or how to exercise it
A clear and express advisement was given

prompt: Did the advisement explain only one type of independent test (e.g. only blood), without mentioning that other types might exist?
Was there anything that may have prevented your client from actually understanding the advisement?

options.label: Advisement was given in a language your client did not adequately understand
Client's intoxication level was so high they could not understand advisement
Other comprehension barrier (e.g. cognitive impairment, disability)
No

prompt: Did the officer say or do anything that discouraged your client from getting an independent chemical test?

options.label: Yes
No
